notes.title: VR Store Simulator Ragdoll Update
notes.notes:
[b]Introduces New Ragdoll Mechanics[/b]
[list]
[*] Punch, slap, or throw NPCs 
[*] Hitting NPCs can stun them or knock them down
[/list]

notes.title: VR Store Simulator - Valentine's Day Update 💘
notes.notes:
Love is in the air! Our Valentine's Day update brings romantic decorations, festive music, and a heartwarming atmosphere to your store. Plus, enjoy a special Valentine's gift just for you! 🎁

✨ What's New?

[list]
[*]Valentine's Day decorations for the store and main menu ❤️
[*]Romantic background music 🎶
[*]A special in-game Valentine's gift 🎁
[*]Improvements and bug fixes for a smoother experience
[/list]
Spread the love and enjoy this festive update! 💕

notes.title: Fix & Improve Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed various tutorial issues.
[*] Improved saving and loading:
[*] Products now stay in place properly.
[*] No more products flying around when loading a game.
[*] Loading is now smoother and more accurate.
[*] Fixed a bug that could break the game when restocking.
[*] Hands no longer go through walls after teleporting.
[*] Improved card machine interaction:
[*] Button presses now have a short delay to prevent mistakes.
[*] Swiping the card feels more natural.
[*] Added placement guides when setting up furniture.
[/list]

notes.title: VR Store Simulator Update: Product Indicators and Improved Interactions
notes.notes:
Product Indicators: Shelves, fridges, and freezers now show indicators for stocked products.

Improved Placement: Better product placement on furniture.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed issue with cash getting stuck after closing the cash register.

Corrected scaling issue with "SausagePack."

Customers: Slightly faster interaction animations.

UI Adjustments: Moved total price panel on the cash register to the left.

Rewards Update:

Boxing Machine: XP reward increased from 5 to 10, cash reward increased from $5 to $10.

Recycling empty boxes now gives +1 XP and +$1.

New Management Page: Coming soon.
